pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: WITH data AS (SELECT district, year, institutional_deliveries, pregnancies_registered, postnatal_check_48h FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023)) SELECT district, year, institutional_deliveries, CASE WHEN NOT pregnancies_registered IS NULL AND pregnancies_registered > 0 THEN (institutional_deliveries * 100.0 / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS institutional_delivery_percentage, postnatal_check_48h, CASE WHEN NOT pregnancies_registered IS NULL AND pregnancies_registered > 0 THEN (postnatal_check_48h * 100.0 / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS postnatal_check_percentage FROM data

attempts.response:
WITH data AS (
    SELECT
        district,
        year,
        institutional_deliveries,
        pregnancies_registered,
        postnatal_check_48h
    FROM maternal_services
    WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
      AND year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT
    district,
    year,
    institutional_deliveries,
    CASE
        WHEN pregnancies_registered IS NOT NULL AND pregnancies_registered > 0
        THEN (institutional_deliveries * 100.0 / pregnancies_registered)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS institutional_delivery_percentage,
    postnatal_check_48h,
    CASE
        WHEN pregnancies_registered IS NOT NULL AND pregnancies_registered > 0
        THEN (postnatal_check_48h * 100.0 / pregnancies_registered)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS postnatal_check_percentage
FROM data;
